import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import type { Prisma } from "@prisma/client";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";

export const runtime = "nodejs";

// קבלת אירועי שימוש. בלי consent=true לא נשמר כלום.
export async function POST(req: Request) {
  let body: any;
  try { body = await req.json(); } catch { return NextResponse.json({ error: "bad json" }, { status: 400 }); }
  const { anonId, platform, appVersion, consent, events } = body ?? {};
  if (consent !== true) return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, reason: "no consent" }, { status: 202 });
  if (typeof anonId !== "string" || anonId.length > 64 || !Array.isArray(events)) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "bad payload" }, { status: 400 });
  }
  const list = events
    .slice(0, 50)
    .filter((e: any) => typeof e?.type === "string" && e.type.length <= 40 && JSON.stringify(e.props ?? {}).length <= 2000);

  const device = await prisma.device.upsert({
    where: { anonId },
    update: { platform: String(platform ?? "").slice(0, 40), appVersion: String(appVersion ?? "").slice(0, 20), consent: true },
    create: { anonId, platform: String(platform ?? "").slice(0, 40), appVersion: String(appVersion ?? "").slice(0, 20), consent: true, consentAt: new Date() },
  });
  await prisma.event.createMany({
    data: list.map((e: any) => ({ deviceId: device.id, type: e.type, props: (e.props ?? {}) as Prisma.InputJsonValue })),
  });
  return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, saved: list.length });
}

// זכות למחיקה: מוחק את המכשיר ואת כל האירועים שלו
export async function DELETE(req: Request) {
  const anonId = new URL(req.url).searchParams.get("anonId");
  if (!anonId) return NextResponse.json({ error: "missing anonId" }, { status: 400 });
  await prisma.device.deleteMany({ where: { anonId } });
  return NextResponse.json({ ok: true });
}

export const runtime = "nodejs";

const KINDS = ["bug", "idea", "love", "other"];

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  let b: any;
  try { b = await req.json(); } catch { return NextResponse.json({ error: "bad json" }, { status: 400 }); }
  const message = typeof b?.message === "string" ? b.message.trim().slice(0, 2000) : "";
  if (!message) return NextResponse.json({ error: "empty" }, { status: 400 });
  await prisma.feedback.create({
    data: { kind: KINDS.includes(b.kind) ? b.kind : "other", message, appVersion: String(b.appVersion ?? "").slice(0, 20) },
  });
  return NextResponse.json({ ok: true });
}

// שערי מטבע מהרשת. מחזיר "כמה ₪ שווה יחידה אחת" לכל מטבע נתמך.
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { CURRENCIES } from "@/lib/constants";

export const revalidate = 3600;

export async function GET() {
  const key = process.env.EXCHANGE_RATE_API_KEY;
  const url = key
    ? `https://v6.exchangerate-api.com/v6/${key}/latest/ILS`
    : "https://open.er-api.com/v6/latest/ILS";
  try {
    const res = await fetch(url, { next: { revalidate: 3600 } });
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`status ${res.status}`);
    const json = await res.json();
    const perIls: Record<string, number> = json.conversion_rates ?? json.rates ?? {};
    const rates: Record<string, number> = {};
    for (const c of CURRENCIES) {
      if (c.code === "ILS") continue;
      const v = perIls[c.code];
      if (typeof v === "number" && v > 0) rates[c.code] = 1 / v; // הנתון בא כ"מטבע ל-₪1", אנחנו צריכים את ההפוך
    }
    return NextResponse.json({ rates, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() });
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "לא הצלחנו להביא שערים. אפשר להזין ידנית בהגדרות." }, { status: 502 });
  }
}

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { timingSafeEqual } from "crypto";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

function authorized(req: Request) {
  const token = process.env.ADMIN_TOKEN;
  if (!token) return false; // בלי טוקן מוגדר, הנתיב סגור
  const given = (req.headers.get("authorization") ?? "").replace(/^Bearer\s+/i, "");
  const a = Buffer.from(given), b = Buffer.from(token);
  return a.length === b.length && timingSafeEqual(a, b);
}

// curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" http://localhost:3000/api/stats
export async function GET(req: Request) {
  if (!authorized(req)) return NextResponse.json({ error: "unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });

  const [totals, daily, byCategory, byCurrency, byMethod, feedback] = await Promise.all([
    prisma.$queryRaw`SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "Device" WHERE consent)::int AS devices,
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "Device" WHERE "lastSeenAt" > now() - interval '7 days')::int AS active_7d,
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "Event")::int AS events,
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "Feedback")::int AS feedback`,
    prisma.$queryRaw`SELECT to_char(date_trunc('day',"createdAt"),'YYYY-MM-DD') AS day, COUNT(DISTINCT "deviceId")::int AS active_devices, COUNT(*)::int AS events
      FROM "Event" WHERE "createdAt" > now() - interval '30 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1`,
    prisma.$queryRaw`SELECT props->>'category' AS category, COUNT(*)::int AS n, ROUND(SUM((props->>'amountIls')::numeric),2)::float8 AS total_ils, ROUND(AVG((props->>'amountIls')::numeric),2)::float8 AS avg_ils
      FROM "Event" WHERE type='expense_added' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY total_ils DESC`,
    prisma.$queryRaw`SELECT props->>'currency' AS currency, COUNT(*)::int AS n, ROUND(SUM((props->>'amountIls')::numeric),2)::float8 AS total_ils
      FROM "Event" WHERE type='expense_added' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY n DESC`,
    prisma.$queryRaw`SELECT props->>'method' AS method, COUNT(*)::int AS n FROM "Event" WHERE type='expense_added' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY n DESC`,
    prisma.feedback.findMany({ orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" }, take: 20 }),
  ]);
  return NextResponse.json({ totals, daily, byCategory, byCurrency, byMethod, feedback });
}

// מעטפת האפליקציה: ניווט, כפתור הוספה מהירה, טעינת נתונים שמורים ורישום service worker
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { LayoutDashboard, Plus, Receipt, Settings, Users, Wallet } from "lucide-react";
import { useTripStore, useUiStore } from "@/store/useTripStore";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

import { CashVault } from "./CashVault";
import { SettingsPanel } from "./SettingsPanel";
import { ExpenseFormModal } from "./ExpenseFormModal";
import { BetaCard } from "./BetaCard";

const TABS = [
  { id: "expenses", label: "הוצאות", icon: Receipt },
  { id: "overview", label: "סקירה", icon: LayoutDashboard },
  { id: "group", label: "קבוצה", icon: Users },
  { id: "cash", label: "מזומן", icon: Wallet },
  { id: "settings", label: "הגדרות", icon: Settings },
] as const;
type TabId = (typeof TABS)[number]["id"];

export function AppShell() {
  const [ready, setReady] = useState(false);
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<TabId>("expenses");
  const tripName = useTripStore((s) => s.trip.name);
  const openExpense = useUiStore((s) => s.openExpense);

  useEffect(() => {
    useTripStore.persist.rehydrate();
    setReady(true);
    if (process.env.NODE_ENV === "production" && "serviceWorker" in navigator) navigator.serviceWorker.register("/sw.js").catch(() => {});
  }, []);

  if (!ready) return <div className="grid min-h-dvh place-items-center text-ink-soft">טוען…</div>;

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto min-h-dvh max-w-5xl px-4 pb-28 pt-5 sm:px-6">
      <header className="mb-5 flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <h1 className="font-display text-2xl font-semibold sm:text-3xl">{tripName}</h1>
        <nav className="glass hidden gap-1 p-1 sm:flex" aria-label="ניווט ראשי">
          {TABS.map((t) => (
            <button key={t.id} onClick={() => setTab(t.id)} aria-current={tab === t.id ? "page" : undefined}
              className={cn("flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-sm font-medium", tab === t.id ? "bg-lagoon text-white" : "text-ink-soft hover:bg-white/70")}>
              <t.icon size={16} />{t.label}
            </button>
          ))}
        </nav>
      </header>

      <main className="space-y-4">
        {tab === "overview" && <><DashboardOverview /><FinancialCharts /></>}
        {tab === "expenses" && <PreTripVsRoadBreakdown />}
        {tab === "group" && <GroupSplitter />}
        {tab === "cash" && <CashVault />}
        {tab === "settings" && <><BetaCard /><SettingsPanel /></>}
      </main>

      {/* הוספה מהירה: צף מעל הניווט התחתון */}
      <button onClick={() => openExpense("road")} aria-label="הוסף הוצאה"
        className="fixed bottom-24 start-5 z-30 grid h-14 w-14 place-items-center rounded-full bg-ink text-white shadow-xl transition-transform hover:scale-105 sm:bottom-8">
        <Plus size={28} />

        {TABS.map((t) => (

}

"use client";
// כרטיס בטא: הסכמה לאנליטיקה אנונימית + שליחת משוב
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { hasConsent, setConsent } from "@/lib/track";
import { Button, Card } from "./ui/ui";

export function BetaCard() {
  const [consent, setC] = useState(false);
  const [kind, setKind] = useState("bug");
  const [text, setText] = useState("");
  const [msg, setMsg] = useState("");
  useEffect(() => setC(hasConsent()), []);

  const send = async () => {
    if (!text.trim()) return;
    const r = await fetch("/api/feedback", {
      method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ kind, message: text, appVersion: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_VERSION }),
    }).catch(() => null);
    setMsg(r?.ok ? "תודה! המשוב נשלח" : "לא הצלחנו לשלוח, בדוק חיבור ונסה שוב");
    if (r?.ok) setText("");
  };

  return (
    <Card>
      <h3 className="font-display text-lg font-semibold">בטא ופרטיות</h3>
      <label className="mt-3 flex items-start gap-2 text-sm">
        <input type="checkbox" className="mt-1 h-4 w-4 accent-lagoon" checked={consent}
          onChange={(e) => { setConsent(e.target.checked); setC(e.target.checked); }} />
        אני מסכים לשלוח נתוני שימוש אנונימיים (סוג הוצאה, מטבע וסכום, בלי שמות ובלי בתי עסק). אפשר לבטל בכל רגע, וזה גם מוחק את מה שנשלח.
      </label>
      <div className="mt-4 grid gap-2">
        <select className="field" value={kind} onChange={(e) => setKind(e.target.value)} aria-label="סוג משוב">
          <option value="bug">באג</option><option value="idea">רעיון</option><option value="love">אהבתי</option><option value="other">אחר</option>
        </select>
        <textarea className="field h-24" placeholder="מה קרה, או מה היית רוצה?" value={text} onChange={(e) => setText(e.target.value)} />
        <Button onClick={send}>שלח משוב</Button>
        {msg && <p role="status" className="text-sm font-medium">{msg}</p>}
      </div>
    </Card>
  );
}

        {s.wallet.some((w) => w.balance < 0) && (
          <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-reef">יש יתרה שלילית במזומן. כנראה שחסרה משיכה, או שהוצאה נרשמה כמזומן בטעות.</p>
        )}
      </Card>

      {atms.length > 0 && (
        <Card>
          <h3 className="font-display text-lg font-semibold">משיכות</h3>
          <p className="text-sm text-ink-soft">סך העמלות והפסדי ההמרה: <b className="num text-reef">{formatMoney(totalFees)}</b></p>
          <ul className="mt-2 divide-y divide-ink/10">

        </Card>
      )}

}

// סקירה: מסלול ההמראה (כמה ימים נשארו) וכרטיסי הסטטיסטיקה
import { useMemo } from "react";
import { Plane } from "lucide-react";

import { summarize } from "@/lib/selectors";
import { formatMoney } from "@/lib/currency";
import { fmtDate, cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { Button, Card, Empty } from "./ui/ui";

const STATUS = {
  nodata: { text: "עוד אין נתונים", cls: "bg-ink/10 text-ink-soft" },
  ok: { text: "בקצב טוב", cls: "bg-lagoon-mist text-lagoon-deep" },
  tight: { text: "הקצב גבוה מהתכנון", cls: "bg-sun/25 text-sun-deep" },
  over: { text: "חריגה מהתקציב", cls: "bg-reef/15 text-reef" },
} as const;

export function DashboardOverview() {
  const { trip, expenses, rates, loadDemo } = useTripStore();
  const openExpense = useUiStore((s) => s.openExpense);
  const s = useMemo(() => summarize({ trip, expenses, rates }), [trip, expenses, rates]);
  const r = s.runway;

  if (expenses.length === 0) {
    return (
      <Empty title="עוד לא הוספת הוצאות">
        <p>לחץ על + כדי לרשום את ההוצאה הראשונה, או הוסף את הטיסות והביטוח כהוצאות לפני הטיול.</p>
        <div className="mt-3 flex justify-center gap-2">
          <Button onClick={() => openExpense("pre")}>הוסף הוצאה לפני הטיול</Button>
          <Button variant="ghost" onClick={loadDemo}>טען נתוני הדגמה</Button>
        </div>
      </Empty>
    );
  }

  const pct = trip.budgetIls > 0 ? Math.min(100, Math.max(0, (r.totalSpent / trip.budgetIls) * 100)) : 0;
  const st = STATUS[r.status];
  const daysLeftTxt = r.daysLeft === null ? "—" : Math.floor(r.daysLeft).toLocaleString("he-IL");

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* גיבור הדף: מסלול המראה – הטיסה נעה מימין (תחילת הטיול) לשמאל (הכסף נגמר) */}
      <Card>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-end justify-between gap-3">
          <div>
            <p className="text-sm text-ink-soft">הכסף מספיק לעוד</p>
            <p className="num text-5xl font-semibold leading-none sm:text-6xl">
              {daysLeftTxt} <span className="text-2xl font-medium text-ink-soft">ימים</span>
            </p>
          </div>
          <span className={cn("rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-sm font-medium", st.cls)}>{st.text}</span>
        </div>

        <div className="relative mt-5 h-14 overflow-hidden rounded-2xl bg-ink" aria-hidden>
          <div className="absolute inset-y-0 right-0 bg-gradient-to-l from-sun/80 to-sun/20" style={{ width: `${pct}%` }} />
          <div className="absolute inset-x-3 top-1/2 border-t-2 border-dashed border-white/50" />
          <div className="absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 translate-x-1/2" style={{ right: `${Math.min(96, Math.max(4, pct))}%` }}>
            <span className="grid h-9 w-9 place-items-center rounded-full bg-white text-lagoon-deep shadow">
              <Plane size={18} style={{ transform: "rotate(-135deg)" }} />
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="mt-1.5 flex justify-between text-xs text-ink-soft">
          <span>הוצאת {Math.round(pct)}% מהתקציב</span>
          <span>{r.runOutDate ? `בקצב הזה הכסף נגמר ב-${fmtDate(r.runOutDate)}` : "הוסף הוצאות בדרך כדי לחשב קצב"}</span>
        </div>

        {r.recommendedDaily !== null && (
          <p className="mt-3 rounded-xl bg-lagoon-mist/70 p-3 text-sm">
            כדי להגיע ל-{fmtDate(trip.endDate)} מותר להוציא בממוצע <b className="num">{formatMoney(r.recommendedDaily)}</b> ליום.
            {r.avgDaily > 0 && <> כרגע הממוצע הוא <b className="num">{formatMoney(r.avgDaily)}</b>.</>}
          </p>
        )}
      </Card>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 lg:grid-cols-4">
        <Stat label="תקציב כולל" value={formatMoney(trip.budgetIls)} />
        <Stat label="הוצאתי" value={formatMoney(r.totalSpent)} sub={r.preTripSpent > 0 ? `מזה ${formatMoney(r.preTripSpent)} לפני הטיול` : undefined} />
        <Stat label="נשאר" value={formatMoney(r.remaining)} tone={r.remaining < 0 ? "bad" : "good"} />
        <Stat label="ממוצע יומי בדרך" value={r.daysElapsed ? formatMoney(r.avgDaily) : "—"} sub={r.daysElapsed ? `7 ימים אחרונים: ${formatMoney(r.recentDaily)}` : undefined} />
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
        <Stat label="מזומן בארנק (שווי)" value={formatMoney(s.cashIls)} sub={s.wallet.filter((w) => w.balance > 0).map((w) => formatMoney(w.balance, w.currency)).join(", ") || undefined} />
        <Stat label="נשאר בכרטיס" value={formatMoney(s.cardIls)} tone={s.cardIls < 0 ? "bad" : undefined} />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function Stat({ label, value, sub, tone }: { label: string; value: string; sub?: string; tone?: "good" | "bad" }) {
  return (
    <div className="glass p-3.5 sm:p-4">
      <p className="text-sm text-ink-soft">{label}</p>
      <p className={cn("num mt-1 text-2xl font-semibold", tone === "bad" && "text-reef", tone === "good" && "text-lagoon-deep")}>{value}</p>
      {sub && <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-ink-mute">{sub}</p>}
    </div>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";

const defaultCat: Record<ExpenseMode, CategoryId> = { road: "food", pre: "flights", atm: "atm" };

export function ExpenseFormModal() {
  const { open, mode: initialMode } = useUiStore((s) => s.expenseModal);
  const close = useUiStore((s) => s.closeExpense);
  const { trip, members, rates, lastCurrency, addExpense } = useTripStore();

  const [mode, setMode] = useState<ExpenseMode>("road");
  const [amount, setAmount] = useState("");
  const [currency, setCurrency] = useState("USD");
  const [rateStr, setRateStr] = useState("");
  const [charged, setCharged] = useState("");
  const [category, setCategory] = useState<CategoryId>("food");
  const [method, setMethod] = useState<PaymentMethod>("card");
  const [date, setDate] = useState(todayStr());
  const [title, setTitle] = useState("");
  const [note, setNote] = useState("");
  const [paidBy, setPaidBy] = useState(trip.meId);
  const [shared, setShared] = useState(false);
  const [split, setSplit] = useState<string[]>([]);

  // איפוס בכל פתיחה
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    setMode(initialMode);
    setCategory(defaultCat[initialMode]);
    setAmount(""); setRateStr(""); setCharged(""); setTitle(""); setNote("");
    setCurrency(initialMode === "pre" ? "ILS" : lastCurrency);
    setMethod(initialMode === "road" ? "cash" : "card");
    setDate(todayStr()); setPaidBy(trip.meId); setShared(false);
    setSplit(members.map((m) => m.id));
  }, [open]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps

  const switchMode = (m: ExpenseMode) => {
    setMode(m); setCategory(defaultCat[m]);
    if (m === "atm") { setMethod("card"); setShared(false); setPaidBy(trip.meId); }
  };

  const storeRate = getRate(rates, currency) ?? 0;
  const rate = parseFloat(rateStr) > 0 ? parseFloat(rateStr) : storeRate;
  const amountNum = parseFloat(amount) || 0;
  const marketIls = toIls(amountNum, rate);
  const chargedNum = charged ? parseFloat(charged) || 0 : marketIls;
  const fee = mode === "atm" ? Math.max(0, round2(chargedNum - marketIls)) : 0;
  const valid = amountNum > 0 && rate > 0 && (shared ? split.length > 0 : true);

  const cats = useMemo(() => CATEGORIES.filter((c) => (mode === "pre" ? c.group === "pre" : mode === "road" ? c.group === "road" && c.id !== "atm" : false)), [mode]);
  const multi = members.length > 1;

  const submit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!valid) return;
    const catLabel = CATEGORIES.find((c) => c.id === category)!.label;
    addExpense({
      title: title.trim() || (mode === "atm" ? `משיכה ב-${currency}` : catLabel),
      note: note.trim() || undefined,
      category: mode === "atm" ? "atm" : category,
      paymentMethod: mode === "atm" ? "card" : method,
      isPreTrip: mode === "pre",
      isShared: mode !== "atm" && shared,
      date, amount: amountNum, currency, rateToIls: rate,
      amountIls: mode === "atm" ? chargedNum : marketIls,
      feeIls: fee,
      paidBy: mode === "atm" ? trip.meId : paidBy,
      splitAmong: mode !== "atm" && shared ? split : [],
    });
    close();
  };

  return (
    <Modal open={open} onClose={close} title="הוצאה חדשה">
      <form onSubmit={submit} className="space-y-4">
        <Segmented value={mode} onChange={switchMode} options={[
          { value: "road", label: "בדרך" }, { value: "pre", label: "לפני הטיול" }, { value: "atm", label: "משיכת מזומן" },
        ]} />

        <div className="grid grid-cols-[1fr_auto] gap-2">
          <Field label={mode === "atm" ? "מזומן שהתקבל" : "סכום"}>
            <input autoFocus inputMode="decimal" type="number" step="any" min="0" className="field num text-2xl font-semibold" placeholder="0" value={amount} onChange={(e) => setAmount(e.target.value)} />
          </Field>
          <Field label="מטבע">
            <select className="field h-[3.25rem]" value={currency} onChange={(e) => { setCurrency(e.target.value); setRateStr(""); }}>
              {CURRENCIES.map((c) => <option key={c.code} value={c.code}>{c.symbol} {c.code}</option>)}
            </select>
          </Field>
        </div>

        {/* תצוגה מקדימה בשקלים */}
        <div className="rounded-2xl bg-lagoon-mist/70 p-3">
          <p className="text-sm text-ink-soft">{mode === "atm" ? "שווי לפי השער" : "שווה בשקלים"}</p>
          <p className="num text-3xl font-semibold text-lagoon-deep">{formatMoney(marketIls)}</p>
          {currency !== "ILS" && <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-ink-soft">שער: {rate ? rate.toLocaleString("he-IL", { maximumSignificantDigits: 5 }) : "חסר שער"} ₪ ל-{currency}</p>}
        </div>

        {currency !== "ILS" && (
          <Field label="שער אחר (אופציונלי)" hint="למשל השער שקיבלת בפועל בכספומט או בחברת האשראי">
            <input inputMode="decimal" type="number" step="any" className="field" placeholder={String(storeRate)} value={rateStr} onChange={(e) => setRateStr(e.target.value)} />
          </Field>
        )}

        {mode === "atm" ? (
          <Field label="כמה חויב בכרטיס (₪)" hint="אם תשאיר ריק נשתמש בשווי לפי השער">
            <input inputMode="decimal" type="number" step="any" className="field" placeholder={String(marketIls || "")} value={charged} onChange={(e) => setCharged(e.target.value)} />
            {amountNum > 0 && <span className="mt-1 block text-sm font-medium text-reef">עמלה והפסד המרה: {formatMoney(fee)}</span>}
          </Field>
        ) : (
          <>
            <div>
              <span className="mb-1 block text-sm font-medium text-ink-soft">קטגוריה</span>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                {cats.map((c) => (
                  <button key={c.id} type="button" onClick={() => setCategory(c.id)} aria-pressed={category === c.id}
                    className={cn("rounded-full border px-3 py-1.5 text-sm transition-colors", category === c.id ? "border-transparent text-white" : "border-ink/15 bg-white/70 text-ink-soft hover:bg-white")}
                    style={category === c.id ? { background: c.color } : undefined}>
                    {c.label}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
            <Field label="אמצעי תשלום">
              <Segmented value={method} onChange={setMethod} options={[{ value: "cash", label: "מזומן" }, { value: "card", label: "כרטיס אשראי" }]} />
            </Field>
          </>
        )}

        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
          <Field label="תאריך"><input type="date" className="field" value={date} onChange={(e) => setDate(e.target.value)} /></Field>
          {multi && mode !== "atm" && (
            <Field label="מי שילם">
              <select className="field" value={paidBy} onChange={(e) => setPaidBy(e.target.value)}>
                {members.map((m) => <option key={m.id} value={m.id}>{m.name}</option>)}
              </select>
            </Field>
          )}
        </div>

        {multi && mode !== "atm" && (
          <div className="rounded-2xl border border-ink/10 bg-white/50 p-3">
            <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-medium">
              <input type="checkbox" className="h-4 w-4 accent-lagoon" checked={shared} onChange={(e) => setShared(e.target.checked)} />
              הוצאה משותפת, לחלק שווה בשווה
            </label>
            {shared && (
              <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                {members.map((m) => {
                  const on = split.includes(m.id);
                  return (
                    <button key={m.id} type="button" aria-pressed={on} onClick={() => setSplit(on ? split.filter((x) => x !== m.id) : [...split, m.id])}
                      className={cn("rounded-full border px-3 py-1 text-sm", on ? "border-lagoon bg-lagoon text-white" : "border-ink/15 bg-white text-ink-soft")}>
                      {m.name}
                    </button>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        )}

        <Field label="כותרת (אופציונלי)"><input className="field" placeholder="למשל: ארוחת ערב בשוק" value={title} onChange={(e) => setTitle(e.target.value)} /></Field>
        <Field label="הערה (אופציונלי)"><input className="field" value={note} onChange={(e) => setNote(e.target.value)} /></Field>

        <Button type="submit" disabled={!valid} className="w-full py-3 text-base">שמור הוצאה</Button>
      </form>
    </Modal>
  );
}

"use client";
// גרפים: פילוח לפי קטגוריה (טבעת) ומגמת הוצאות יומית (עמודות)
import { useMemo } from "react";
import { Bar, BarChart, Cell, Pie, PieChart, ReferenceLine, ResponsiveContainer, Tooltip, XAxis, YAxis } from "recharts";
import { useTripStore } from "@/store/useTripStore";
import { summarize } from "@/lib/selectors";
import { formatMoney } from "@/lib/currency";
import { Card } from "./ui/ui";

export function FinancialCharts() {
  const { trip, expenses, rates } = useTripStore();
  const s = useMemo(() => summarize({ trip, expenses, rates }), [trip, expenses, rates]);
  const total = s.byCategory.reduce((a, c) => a + c.value, 0);
  if (!total) return null;

  return (
    <div className="grid gap-4 lg:grid-cols-2">
      <Card>
        <h3 className="font-display text-lg font-semibold">לאן הלך הכסף</h3>
        <div className="mt-2 flex flex-col items-center gap-4 sm:flex-row">
          <div className="h-48 w-48 shrink-0" dir="ltr" role="img" aria-label="תרשים טבעת של הוצאות לפי קטגוריה">
            <ResponsiveContainer>
              <PieChart>
                <Pie data={s.byCategory} dataKey="value" nameKey="label" innerRadius={54} outerRadius={88} paddingAngle={2} stroke="none">
                  {s.byCategory.map((c) => <Cell key={c.id} fill={c.color} />)}
                </Pie>
                <Tooltip formatter={(v) => formatMoney(Number(v))} />
              </PieChart>
            </ResponsiveContainer>
          </div>
          <ul className="w-full space-y-1.5 text-sm">
            {s.byCategory.map((c) => (
              <li key={c.id} className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <span className="h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full" style={{ background: c.color }} />
                <span className="flex-1">{c.label}</span>
                <span className="num text-ink-soft">{Math.round((c.value / total) * 100)}%</span>
                <span className="num w-24 text-end font-medium">{formatMoney(c.value)}</span>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </div>
      </Card>

      <Card>
        <h3 className="font-display text-lg font-semibold">הוצאות יומיות בדרך</h3>
        {s.daily.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-ink-soft">הוצאות בדרך יופיעו כאן.</p>
        ) : (
          <div className="mt-2 h-52" dir="ltr" role="img" aria-label="תרשים עמודות של הוצאה יומית">
            <ResponsiveContainer>
              <BarChart data={s.daily} margin={{ top: 8, right: 4, left: -16, bottom: 0 }}>
                <XAxis dataKey="date" tickFormatter={(d: string) => d.slice(8) + "/" + d.slice(5, 7)} fontSize={11} tickLine={false} interval="preserveStartEnd" />
                <YAxis fontSize={11} tickLine={false} axisLine={false} />
                <Tooltip formatter={(v) => formatMoney(Number(v))} labelFormatter={(d) => String(d)} cursor={{ fill: "rgba(15,139,141,0.08)" }} />
                {s.runway.avgDaily > 0 && <ReferenceLine y={Math.round(s.runway.avgDaily)} stroke="#C98A0F" strokeDasharray="4 4" />}
                <Bar dataKey="value" fill="#0F8B8D" radius={[6, 6, 0, 0]} />
              </BarChart>
            </ResponsiveContainer>
          </div>
        )}
        {s.runway.avgDaily > 0 && <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-ink-soft">הקו המקווקו הוא הממוצע היומי: {formatMoney(s.runway.avgDaily)}</p>}
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";
// חלוקת חובות קבוצתית: יתרה לכל חבר, וההעברות המינימליות להסדרה
import { useMemo } from "react";
import { ArrowLeft, Check, Trash2 } from "lucide-react";
import { useTripStore } from "@/store/useTripStore";
import { settleGroup } from "@/lib/debts";
import { formatMoney } from "@/lib/currency";
import { todayStr } from "@/lib/runway";
import { cn, fmtDate } from "@/lib/utils";
import { Button, Card, Empty } from "./ui/ui";

export function GroupSplitter() {
  const { members, expenses, settlements, addSettlement, deleteSettlement } = useTripStore();
  const { balances, transfers } = useMemo(() => settleGroup(members, expenses, settlements), [members, expenses, settlements]);
  const name = (id: string) => members.find((m) => m.id === id)?.name ?? "?";
  const sharedCount = expenses.filter((e) => e.isShared).length;

  if (members.length < 2)
    return <Empty title="אתם לבד בטיול">הוסף חברים בהגדרות כדי לחלק הוצאות משותפות.</Empty>;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-3">
        {members.map((m) => {
          const v = (balances[m.id] ?? 0) / 100;
          return (
            <div key={m.id} className="glass p-3.5">
              <p className="font-medium">{m.name}</p>
              <p className={cn("num mt-1 text-xl font-semibold", v > 0 && "text-lagoon-deep", v < 0 && "text-reef")}>{formatMoney(Math.abs(v))}</p>
              <p className="text-xs text-ink-soft">{v > 0.005 ? "מגיע לו/ה" : v < -0.005 ? "חייב/ת" : "מאוזן/ת"}</p>
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      <Card>
        <h3 className="font-display text-lg font-semibold">מי מעביר למי</h3>
        <p className="text-sm text-ink-soft">{transfers.length ? `${transfers.length} העברות סוגרות את כל החובות (מתוך ${sharedCount} הוצאות משותפות)` : sharedCount ? "הכול מאוזן, אין חובות פתוחים" : "עוד אין הוצאות משותפות. סמן הוצאה כמשותפת בעת ההוספה."}</p>
        <ul className="mt-3 space-y-2">
          {transfers.map((t) => (
            <li key={`${t.from}-${t.to}`} className="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-xl bg-white/70 p-3">
              <p className="flex-1 font-medium">{name(t.from)} <ArrowLeft size={14} className="mx-1 inline text-ink-mute" /> {name(t.to)}</p>
              <p className="num font-semibold">{formatMoney(t.amountIls)}</p>
              <Button variant="ghost" className="px-3 py-1.5" aria-label={`סמן שהעברה מ${name(t.from)} ל${name(t.to)} בוצעה`}
                onClick={() => addSettlement({ from: t.from, to: t.to, amountIls: t.amountIls, date: todayStr() })}>
                <Check size={16} /> שולם
              </Button>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      </Card>

      {settlements.length > 0 && (
        <Card>
          <h3 className="font-display text-lg font-semibold">העברות שבוצעו</h3>
          <ul className="mt-2 divide-y divide-ink/10">
            {[...settlements].reverse().map((s) => (
              <li key={s.id} className="flex items-center gap-3 py-2 text-sm">
                <span className="flex-1">{name(s.from)} העביר/ה ל{name(s.to)}, {fmtDate(s.date)}</span>
                <span className="num font-medium">{formatMoney(s.amountIls)}</span>
                <button aria-label="בטל העברה" className="rounded-full p-1.5 text-ink-mute hover:bg-reef/10 hover:text-reef" onClick={() => deleteSettlement(s.id)}><Trash2 size={15} /></button>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </Card>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";
// לשוניות: הוצאות קבועות לפני הטיול מול הוצאות יומיות בדרך
import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { Banknote, CreditCard, Trash2, Users } from "lucide-react";
import { useTripStore, useUiStore } from "@/store/useTripStore";
import { CATEGORY_BY_ID } from "@/lib/constants";
import { formatMoney } from "@/lib/currency";
import { myShareIls } from "@/lib/selectors";
import { fmtDate } from "@/lib/utils";
import { Button, Card, Empty, Segmented } from "./ui/ui";

export function PreTripVsRoadBreakdown() {
  const { expenses, members, trip, deleteExpense } = useTripStore();
  const openExpense = useUiStore((s) => s.openExpense);
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<"pre" | "road">("road");

  const list = useMemo(
    () => expenses.filter((e) => (tab === "pre") === e.isPreTrip).sort((a, b) => b.date.localeCompare(a.date)),
    [expenses, tab],
  );
  const total = list.reduce((s, e) => s + myShareIls(e, trip.meId), 0);
  const byCat = useMemo(() => {
    const m = new Map<string, number>();
    list.forEach((e) => m.set(e.category, (m.get(e.category) ?? 0) + myShareIls(e, trip.meId)));
    return [...m.entries()].filter(([, v]) => v > 0).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]);
  }, [list, trip.meId]);
  const name = (id: string) => members.find((m) => m.id === id)?.name ?? "";

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <Segmented value={tab} onChange={setTab} options={[{ value: "road", label: "בדרך" }, { value: "pre", label: "לפני הטיול" }]} />
      <Card>
        <div className="flex items-end justify-between">
          <div>
            <p className="text-sm text-ink-soft">{tab === "pre" ? "הוצאות קבועות שלי" : "הוצאות שלי בדרך"}</p>
            <p className="num text-3xl font-semibold">{formatMoney(total)}</p>
          </div>
          <Button variant="ghost" onClick={() => openExpense(tab)}>הוסף</Button>
        </div>
        {byCat.length > 0 && (
          <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
            {byCat.map(([id, v]) => (
              <span key={id} className="rounded-full bg-white/70 px-3 py-1 text-sm">
                <span className="ms-0 me-1.5 inline-block h-2 w-2 rounded-full" style={{ background: CATEGORY_BY_ID[id as keyof typeof CATEGORY_BY_ID].color }} />
                {CATEGORY_BY_ID[id as keyof typeof CATEGORY_BY_ID].label} <b className="num">{formatMoney(v)}</b>
              </span>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </Card>

      {list.length === 0 ? (
        <Empty title={tab === "pre" ? "אין עדיין הוצאות לפני הטיול" : "אין עדיין הוצאות בדרך"}>
          {tab === "pre" ? "טיסות, ביטוח, חיסונים, ציוד וויזות." : "לינה, אוכל, תחבורה ועוד."}
        </Empty>
      ) : (
        <ul className="space-y-2">
          {list.map((e) => {
            const cat = CATEGORY_BY_ID[e.category];
            return (
              <li key={e.id} className="glass flex items-center gap-3 p-3">
                <span className="h-10 w-1.5 shrink-0 rounded-full" style={{ background: cat.color }} />
                <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <p className="truncate font-medium">{e.title}</p>
                  <p className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-2 text-xs text-ink-soft">
                    <span>{cat.label}</span><span>{fmtDate(e.date)}</span>
                    {e.paymentMethod === "cash" && e.category !== "atm" ? <Banknote size={13} aria-label="מזומן" /> : <CreditCard size={13} aria-label="כרטיס" />}
                    {members.length > 1 && <span>שילם/ה: {name(e.paidBy)}</span>}
                    {e.isShared && <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1"><Users size={13} />משותף</span>}
                  </p>
                </div>
                <div className="text-end">
                  <p className="num font-semibold">{formatMoney(e.amountIls)}</p>
                  {e.currency !== "ILS" && <p className="num text-xs text-ink-soft">{formatMoney(e.amount, e.currency)}</p>}
                  {e.category === "atm" && e.feeIls > 0 && <p className="text-xs text-reef">עמלה {formatMoney(e.feeIls)}</p>}
                </div>
                <button aria-label={`מחק ${e.title}`} className="rounded-full p-2 text-ink-mute hover:bg-reef/10 hover:text-reef"
                  onClick={() => confirm(`למחוק את "${e.title}"?`) && deleteExpense(e.id)}>
                  <Trash2 size={16} />
                </button>
              </li>
            );
          })}
        </ul>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";
// הגדרות: פרטי טיול, חברים, שערי מטבע, גיבוי וייצוא
import { useRef, useState } from "react";
import { Download, RefreshCw, Trash2, Upload } from "lucide-react";
import { useTripStore } from "@/store/useTripStore";
import { CURRENCIES } from "@/lib/constants";
import { download, expensesToCsv } from "@/lib/utils";
import { Button, Card, Field } from "./ui/ui";

export function SettingsPanel() {
  const st = useTripStore();
  const { trip, members, rates } = st;
  const [newName, setNewName] = useState("");
  const [msg, setMsg] = useState("");
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const fileRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  const refreshRates = async () => {
    setBusy(true); setMsg("");
    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/rates");
      const json = await res.json();
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(json.error);
      st.applyApiRates(json.rates);
      setMsg("השערים עודכנו");
    } catch (e) {
      setMsg((e as Error).message || "אין חיבור לאינטרנט. אפשר להזין שערים ידנית.");
    } finally { setBusy(false); }
  };

  const onImport = async (f?: File) => {
    if (!f) return;
    if (!confirm("הייבוא יחליף את כל הנתונים הקיימים. להמשיך?")) return;
    const r = st.importData(await f.text());
    setMsg(r.ok ? "הנתונים נטענו" : r.error ?? "שגיאה");
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <Card>
        <h3 className="font-display text-lg font-semibold">הטיול</h3>
        <div className="mt-3 grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
          <Field label="שם הטיול"><input className="field" value={trip.name} onChange={(e) => st.setTrip({ name: e.target.value })} /></Field>
          <Field label="תקציב כולל (₪)" hint="כולל טיסות וביטוח"><input type="number" inputMode="decimal" className="field" value={trip.budgetIls || ""} onChange={(e) => st.setTrip({ budgetIls: parseFloat(e.target.value) || 0 })} /></Field>
          <Field label="תאריך יציאה"><input type="date" className="field" value={trip.startDate} onChange={(e) => st.setTrip({ startDate: e.target.value })} /></Field>
          <Field label="תאריך חזרה מתוכנן" hint="מאפשר לחשב כמה מותר להוציא ביום"><input type="date" className="field" value={trip.endDate} onChange={(e) => st.setTrip({ endDate: e.target.value })} /></Field>
        </div>
      </Card>

      <Card>

"use client";
// רכיבי בסיס בסגנון shadcn: כפתור, כרטיס זכוכית, חלון, שדה, לשוניות
import { useEffect, type ButtonHTMLAttributes, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { X } from "lucide-react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

export function Button({
  variant = "primary", className, ...p
}: ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> & { variant?: "primary" | "ghost" | "danger" | "sun" }) {
  const styles = {
    primary: "bg-lagoon text-white hover:bg-lagoon-deep",
    sun: "bg-ink text-white hover:bg-black",
    ghost: "bg-[#F5F5F7] text-ink hover:bg-[#E8E8ED]",
    danger: "bg-reef/10 text-reef hover:bg-reef/20",
  }[variant];
  return (
    <button
      {...p}
      className={cn("inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-full px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-medium transition-colors disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50", styles, className)}
    />
  );
}

export const Card = ({ className, children }: { className?: string; children: ReactNode }) => (
  <section className={cn("glass p-4 sm:p-5", className)}>{children}</section>
);

export const Field = ({ label, hint, children }: { label: string; hint?: string; children: ReactNode }) => (
  <label className="block">
    <span className="mb-1 block text-sm font-medium text-ink-soft">{label}</span>
    {children}
    {hint && <span className="mt-1 block text-xs text-ink-mute">{hint}</span>}
  </label>
);

export function Modal({ open, onClose, title, children }: { open: boolean; onClose: () => void; title: string; children: ReactNode }) {
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => e.key === "Escape" && onClose();
    document.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
    document.body.style.overflow = "hidden";
    return () => { document.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey); document.body.style.overflow = ""; };
  }, [open, onClose]);
  if (!open) return null;
  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-end justify-center sm:items-center" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label={title}>
      <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-ink/40 backdrop-blur-sm" onClick={onClose} />
      <div className="relative max-h-[92dvh] w-full overflow-y-auto rounded-t-3xl border border-white/70 bg-[#F4FAF9]/95 p-5 pb-8 shadow-2xl backdrop-blur-xl sm:max-w-lg sm:rounded-3xl">
        <div className="mb-4 flex items-center justify-between">
          <h2 className="font-display text-xl font-semibold">{title}</h2>
          <button onClick={onClose} aria-label="סגירה" className="rounded-full p-2 hover:bg-ink/5"><X size={20} /></button>
        </div>
        {children}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export function Segmented<T extends string>({ value, onChange, options, className }: {
  value: T; onChange: (v: T) => void; options: { value: T; label: string }[]; className?: string;
}) {
  return (
    <div role="tablist" className={cn("grid auto-cols-fr grid-flow-col rounded-xl bg-ink/5 p-1", className)}>
      {options.map((o) => (
        <button
          key={o.value} role="tab" aria-selected={value === o.value} type="button" onClick={() => onChange(o.value)}
          className={cn("rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm font-medium transition-colors", value === o.value ? "bg-white text-ink shadow-sm" : "text-ink-soft hover:text-ink")}
        >
          {o.label}
        </button>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

export const Empty = ({ title, children }: { title: string; children?: ReactNode }) => (
  <div className="rounded-2xl border border-dashed border-ink/20 p-6 text-center">
    <p className="font-medium">{title}</p>
    {children && <div className="mt-2 text-sm text-ink-soft">{children}</div>}
  </div>
);

// עזרי המרת מטבע ועיצוב סכומים
import type { Rates } from "./types";

/** עיגול לשתי ספרות אחרי הנקודה (אגורות) */
export const round2 = (n: number) => Math.round((n + Number.EPSILON) * 100) / 100;

/** השער של מטבע (₪ ליחידה). שקל = 1. אם אין שער – מחזיר undefined */
export function getRate(rates: Rates, currency: string): number | undefined {
  if (currency === "ILS") return 1;
  return rates[currency]?.rateToIls;
}

/** המרת סכום מקומי לשקלים */
export function toIls(amount: number, rateToIls: number): number {
  return round2(amount * rateToIls);
}

/** המרה כללית בין שני מטבעות דרך השקל */
export function convert(amount: number, from: string, to: string, rates: Rates): number | undefined {
  const rf = getRate(rates, from);
  const rt = getRate(rates, to);
  if (rf === undefined || rt === undefined || rt === 0) return undefined;
  return (amount * rf) / rt;
}

/** עיצוב סכום עם סמל המטבע, בעברית. מטבעות עם ערכים קטנים (דונג, רופיה) בלי שברים */
export function formatMoney(amount: number, currency = "ILS"): string {
  const noDecimals = ["IDR", "VND", "JPY", "COP", "ARS"].includes(currency) || Math.abs(amount) >= 1000;
  try {
    return new Intl.NumberFormat("he-IL", {
      style: "currency",
      currency,
      currencyDisplay: "narrowSymbol",
      minimumFractionDigits: 0,
      maximumFractionDigits: noDecimals ? 0 : 2,
    }).format(amount);
  } catch {
    return `${amount.toFixed(2)} ${currency}`;
  }
}

// מנוע חלוקת חובות קבוצתי
// כל החישוב נעשה באגורות (מספרים שלמים) כדי שלא יהיו שגיאות עיגול של float.
import type { Expense, Member, Settlement, Transfer } from "./types";

const toAgorot = (ils: number) => Math.round(ils * 100);
const toIls = (ag: number) => ag / 100;

/**
 * יתרה נטו לכל חבר, באגורות.
 * חיובי = מגיע לו כסף מהקבוצה. שלילי = הוא חייב לקבוצה.
 * רק הוצאות משותפות נספרות. משיכות ATM תמיד אישיות.
 */
export function computeBalances(
  members: Member[],
  expenses: Expense[],
  settlements: Settlement[] = [],
): Record<string, number> {
  const bal: Record<string, number> = Object.fromEntries(members.map((m) => [m.id, 0]));
  const known = new Set(members.map((m) => m.id));

  for (const e of expenses) {
    if (!e.isShared || e.category === "atm") continue;
    const parts = [...new Set(e.splitAmong)].filter((id) => known.has(id)).sort();
    if (parts.length === 0 || !known.has(e.paidBy)) continue;

    const total = toAgorot(e.amountIls);
    const base = Math.floor(total / parts.length);
    let remainder = total - base * parts.length; // האגורות שנשארו מחולקות לראשונים, כך שהסכום תמיד מדויק

    bal[e.paidBy] += total;
    for (const id of parts) {
      const share = base + (remainder > 0 ? 1 : 0);
      if (remainder > 0) remainder--;
      bal[id] -= share;
    }
  }

  // העברה שבוצעה בפועל: המשלם "סגר" חוב, לכן היתרה שלו עולה והמקבל יורדת
  for (const s of settlements) {
    if (!known.has(s.from) || !known.has(s.to)) continue;
    const ag = toAgorot(s.amountIls);
    bal[s.from] += ag;
    bal[s.to] -= ag;
  }
  return bal;
}

const EXACT_LIMIT = 10; // עד מספר זה של חברים עם יתרה פתוחה – פתרון מדויק

/**
 * מינימום העברות להסדרת כל החובות.
 * עד 10 חברים עם יתרה: חיפוש מדויק (backtracking) שמבטיח מספר העברות מינימלי.
 * מעבר לזה: אלגוריתם חמדני (עד n-1 העברות, כמעט תמיד אופטימלי).
 */
export function minimizeTransfers(balances: Record<string, number>): Transfer[] {
  const people = Object.entries(balances).filter(([, v]) => v !== 0);
  const ids = people.map(([id]) => id);
  const vals = people.map(([, v]) => v);

  const result: { from: number; to: number; ag: number }[] =
    ids.length <= EXACT_LIMIT ? exact(vals) : greedy(vals);

  return result
    .map((t) => ({ from: ids[t.from], to: ids[t.to], amountIls: toIls(t.ag) }))
    .sort((a, b) => b.amountIls - a.amountIls);
}

type Move = { from: number; to: number; ag: number };

function exact(vals: number[]): Move[] {
  const arr = [...vals];
  let best = null as Move[] | null;

  const dfs = (start: number, acc: Move[]) => {
    while (start < arr.length && arr[start] === 0) start++;
    if (best && acc.length >= best.length) return; // חיתוך: כבר לא ננצח את הפתרון הטוב ביותר
    if (start === arr.length) {
      best = [...acc];
      return;
    }
    const seen = new Set<number>();
    for (let i = start + 1; i < arr.length; i++) {
      // רק מול מי שהסימן שלו הפוך, ובלי לבדוק ערכים זהים פעמיים
      if (arr[i] * arr[start] >= 0 || seen.has(arr[i])) continue;
      seen.add(arr[i]);
      const move: Move =
        arr[start] < 0
          ? { from: start, to: i, ag: -arr[start] }
          : { from: i, to: start, ag: arr[start] };
      arr[i] += arr[start];
      const saved = arr[start];
      arr[start] = 0;
      acc.push(move);
      dfs(start + 1, acc);
      acc.pop();
      arr[start] = saved;
      arr[i] -= saved;
    }
  };
  dfs(0, []);
  return best ?? [];
}

function greedy(vals: number[]): Move[] {
  const arr = [...vals];
  const moves: Move[] = [];
  for (;;) {
    let max = 0, min = 0;
    for (let i = 1; i < arr.length; i++) {
      if (arr[i] > arr[max]) max = i;
      if (arr[i] < arr[min]) min = i;
    }
    if (arr[max] === 0 || arr[min] === 0) break;
    const ag = Math.min(arr[max], -arr[min]);
    moves.push({ from: min, to: max, ag });
    arr[max] -= ag;
    arr[min] += ag;
  }
  return moves;
}

/** קיצור: מהוצאות והעברות ישר להעברות מומלצות */
export function settleGroup(members: Member[], expenses: Expense[], settlements: Settlement[] = []) {
  const balances = computeBalances(members, expenses, settlements);
  return { balances, transfers: minimizeTransfers(balances) };
}

// חישוב קצב שריפה ו"מסלול הנחיתה": כמה ימים נשארו עד שנגמר הכסף
export interface CostPoint {
  date: string; // YYYY-MM-DD
  ils: number; // העלות שלי (החלק שלי בהוצאה)
  isPreTrip: boolean;
}

export interface RunwayInput {
  budgetIls: number;
  costs: CostPoint[];
  startDate?: string;
  endDate?: string;
  today?: string; // לבדיקות. ברירת מחדל: היום
}

export interface RunwayResult {
  totalSpent: number;
  preTripSpent: number;
  roadSpent: number;
  remaining: number;
  daysElapsed: number; // ימי טיול שעברו
  avgDaily: number; // ממוצע יומי מתחילת הטיול
  recentDaily: number; // ממוצע ב-7 הימים האחרונים
  daysLeft: number | null; // null = אין עדיין נתונים
  runOutDate: string | null;
  daysToEnd: number | null; // ימים עד תאריך סיום מתוכנן
  recommendedDaily: number | null; // כמה מותר להוציא ביום כדי להגיע לסוף
  status: "nodata" | "ok" | "tight" | "over";
}

const MS = 86_400_000;
const parse = (d: string) => Date.UTC(+d.slice(0, 4), +d.slice(5, 7) - 1, +d.slice(8, 10));
export const diffDays = (a: string, b: string) => Math.round((parse(b) - parse(a)) / MS);
export const addDays = (d: string, n: number) => new Date(parse(d) + n * MS).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
export const todayStr = () => {
  const n = new Date();
  return `${n.getFullYear()}-${String(n.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0")}-${String(n.getDate()).padStart(2, "0")}`;
};

export function computeRunway(input: RunwayInput): RunwayResult {
  const today = input.today ?? todayStr();
  const road = input.costs.filter((c) => !c.isPreTrip);
  const preTripSpent = sum(input.costs.filter((c) => c.isPreTrip));
  const roadSpent = sum(road);
  const totalSpent = preTripSpent + roadSpent;
  const remaining = input.budgetIls - totalSpent;

  const base: RunwayResult = {
    totalSpent, preTripSpent, roadSpent, remaining,
    daysElapsed: 0, avgDaily: 0, recentDaily: 0,
    daysLeft: null, runOutDate: null, daysToEnd: null, recommendedDaily: null,
    status: remaining < 0 ? "over" : "nodata",
  };

  // תאריך סיום מתוכנן (אם הוגדר ועדיין לא עבר)
  if (input.endDate && input.endDate >= today) {
    base.daysToEnd = diffDays(today, input.endDate) + 1; // כולל היום
    if (remaining > 0) base.recommendedDaily = remaining / base.daysToEnd;
  }

  if (road.length === 0) return base;

  // נקודת ההתחלה: תחילת הטיול, או ההוצאה הראשונה בדרך אם היא מוקדמת יותר
  const firstRoad = road.reduce((m, c) => (c.date < m ? c.date : m), road[0].date);
  const lastRoad = road.reduce((m, c) => (c.date > m ? c.date : m), road[0].date);
  const start = input.startDate && input.startDate < firstRoad ? input.startDate : firstRoad;
  const end = today > lastRoad ? today : lastRoad;
  const daysElapsed = Math.max(1, diffDays(start, end) + 1);

  const avgDaily = roadSpent / daysElapsed;
  const windowDays = Math.min(7, daysElapsed);
  const windowStart = addDays(end, -(windowDays - 1));
  const recentDaily = sum(road.filter((c) => c.date >= windowStart && c.date <= end)) / windowDays;

  const daysLeft = remaining <= 0 ? 0 : avgDaily > 0 ? remaining / avgDaily : null;
  const runOutDate = daysLeft === null ? null : addDays(today, Math.floor(daysLeft));

  let status: RunwayResult["status"] = "ok";
  if (remaining < 0) status = "over";
  else if (daysLeft !== null && base.daysToEnd !== null && daysLeft < base.daysToEnd) status = "tight";

  return { ...base, daysElapsed, avgDaily, recentDaily, daysLeft, runOutDate, status };
}

function sum(list: CostPoint[]) {
  return list.reduce((s, c) => s + c.ils, 0);
}

// חישובי סיכום שנגזרים מהנתונים השמורים (פונקציות טהורות, ניתנות לבדיקה)
import type { Expense, Rates, TripInfo } from "./types";
import { computeRunway, addDays, diffDays, todayStr } from "./runway.ts";
import { CATEGORY_BY_ID } from "./constants.ts";

/**
 * החלק שלי בהוצאה – מה שנספר בתקציב האישי.
 * משותפת: חלוקה שווה בין המשתתפים. אישית: רק אם אני שילמתי.
 * משיכת ATM: רק העמלה/הפסד ההמרה (המזומן עצמו עדיין שלי בארנק).
 */
export function myShareIls(e: Expense, meId: string): number {
  if (e.category === "atm") return e.paidBy === meId ? e.feeIls : 0;
  if (e.isShared) {
    const parts = [...new Set(e.splitAmong)];
    return parts.includes(meId) ? e.amountIls / parts.length : 0;
  }
  return e.paidBy === meId ? e.amountIls : 0;
}

export interface WalletLine {
  currency: string;
  received: number; // מזומן שנמשך
  spent: number; // מזומן ששילמתי
  balance: number; // מה שנשאר בארנק (מטבע מקומי)
  basisRate: number; // שער ממוצע שבו נמשך המזומן
  valueIls: number;
}

export function cashWallet(expenses: Expense[], meId: string, rates: Rates): WalletLine[] {
  const m = new Map<string, { received: number; costIls: number; spent: number }>();
  const row = (c: string) => m.get(c) ?? m.set(c, { received: 0, costIls: 0, spent: 0 }).get(c)!;
  for (const e of expenses) {
    if (e.paidBy !== meId) continue;
    if (e.category === "atm") {
      const r = row(e.currency);
      r.received += e.amount;
      r.costIls += e.amountIls;
    } else if (e.paymentMethod === "cash") {
      row(e.currency).spent += e.amount;
    }
  }
  return [...m.entries()].map(([currency, r]) => {
    const basisRate = r.received > 0 ? r.costIls / r.received : (rates[currency]?.rateToIls ?? 0);
    const balance = r.received - r.spent;
    return { currency, received: r.received, spent: r.spent, balance, basisRate, valueIls: Math.max(0, balance) * basisRate };
  });
}

export function summarize(args: { trip: TripInfo; expenses: Expense[]; rates: Rates; today?: string }) {
  const { trip, expenses, rates } = args;
  const today = args.today ?? todayStr();
  const costs = expenses.map((e) => ({ date: e.date, ils: myShareIls(e, trip.meId), isPreTrip: e.isPreTrip }));
  const runway = computeRunway({ budgetIls: trip.budgetIls, costs, startDate: trip.startDate || undefined, endDate: trip.endDate || undefined, today });

  const wallet = cashWallet(expenses, trip.meId, rates);
  const cashIls = wallet.reduce((s, w) => s + w.valueIls, 0);
  const cardIls = runway.remaining - cashIls; // הכרטיס הוא "היתרה" אחרי שהורדנו את המזומן שבארנק

  // פילוח לפי קטגוריה
  const cat = new Map<string, number>();
  expenses.forEach((e, i) => cat.set(e.category, (cat.get(e.category) ?? 0) + costs[i].ils));
  const byCategory = [...cat.entries()]
    .filter(([, v]) => v > 0.005)
    .map(([id, value]) => ({ id, label: CATEGORY_BY_ID[id as keyof typeof CATEGORY_BY_ID].label, color: CATEGORY_BY_ID[id as keyof typeof CATEGORY_BY_ID].color, value }))
    .sort((a, b) => b.value - a.value);

  // הוצאות יומיות בדרך (30 הימים האחרונים), כולל ימים בלי הוצאות
  const perDay = new Map<string, number>();
  expenses.forEach((e, i) => { if (!e.isPreTrip) perDay.set(e.date, (perDay.get(e.date) ?? 0) + costs[i].ils); });
  const daily: { date: string; value: number }[] = [];
  if (perDay.size) {
    const dates = [...perDay.keys()].sort();
    const last = dates[dates.length - 1] > today ? dates[dates.length - 1] : today;
    const span = Math.min(30, diffDays(dates[0], last) + 1);
    for (let i = span - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const d = addDays(last, -i);
      daily.push({ date: d, value: Math.round(perDay.get(d) ?? 0) });
    }
  }
  return { runway, wallet, cashIls, cardIls, byCategory, daily };
}

"use client";
// אנליטיקה אנונימית. שולחת אירועים רק אחרי הסכמה מפורשת של המשתמש.
const CONSENT = "bt-consent";
const ANON = "bt-anon";

export const hasConsent = () => typeof localStorage !== "undefined" && localStorage.getItem(CONSENT) === "1";
export const consentAnswered = () => typeof localStorage !== "undefined" && localStorage.getItem(CONSENT) !== null;

function anonId() {
  let id = localStorage.getItem(ANON);
  if (!id) { id = "d" + crypto.randomUUID().replace(/-/g, "").slice(0, 16); localStorage.setItem(ANON, id); }
  return id;
}

export function setConsent(v: boolean) {
  localStorage.setItem(CONSENT, v ? "1" : "0");
  if (!v) void eraseMyData(); // ביטול הסכמה מוחק גם את מה שכבר נשלח
}

export function track(type: string, props: Record<string, string | number | boolean> = {}) {
  if (typeof window === "undefined" || !hasConsent()) return;
  fetch("/api/events", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      anonId: anonId(), consent: true, platform: navigator.platform,
      appVersion: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_VERSION ?? "0.9.0-beta",
      events: [{ type, props }],
    }),
    keepalive: true,
  }).catch(() => {}); // best effort: בלי אינטרנט האירוע פשוט לא נשלח
}

export async function eraseMyData() {
  await fetch(`/api/events?anonId=${encodeURIComponent(anonId())}`, { method: "DELETE" }).catch(() => {});
}

export type PaymentMethod = "card" | "cash";
export type CategoryGroup = "pre" | "road";

  | "flights" | "insurance" | "vaccinations" | "gear" | "visa" | "preOther"
  | "accommodation" | "food" | "transport" | "activities" | "shopping"
  | "nightlife" | "sim" | "atm" | "other";

  endDate: string; // YYYY-MM-DD או ריק

}

export interface RateInfo {

}
export type Rates = Record<string, RateInfo>;

  amountIls: number; // בהוצאה רגילה: הערך בשקלים. במשיכת ATM: מה שחויב בכרטיס
  feeIls: number; // הפסד המרה/עמלה (רק במשיכות ATM)

}

import clsx, { type ClassValue } from "clsx";
import { twMerge } from "tailwind-merge";
import type { Expense, Member } from "./types";
import { CATEGORY_BY_ID } from "./constants";

export const cn = (...inputs: ClassValue[]) => twMerge(clsx(inputs));

export const uid = () =>
  typeof crypto !== "undefined" && "randomUUID" in crypto
    ? crypto.randomUUID()
    : Math.random().toString(36).slice(2) + Date.now().toString(36);

/** תאריך קריא בעברית, למשל "12 במרץ" */
export const fmtDate = (d: string) =>
  d ? new Date(d + "T00:00:00").toLocaleDateString("he-IL", { day: "numeric", month: "long" }) : "";

/** הורדת קובץ בדפדפן */
export function download(filename: string, content: string, mime: string) {
  const blob = new Blob([content], { type: mime });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement("a");
  a.href = url;
  a.download = filename;
  a.click();
  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
}

const esc = (v: string | number | boolean) => `"${String(v).replace(/"/g, '""')}"`;

/** ייצוא ל-CSV. מתחיל ב-BOM כדי שאקסל יציג עברית נכון */
export function expensesToCsv(expenses: Expense[], members: Member[]): string {
  const name = (id: string) => members.find((m) => m.id === id)?.name ?? "";
  const head = ["תאריך", "כותרת", "קטגוריה", "סוג", "אמצעי תשלום", "סכום מקומי", "מטבע", "שער לשקל", "סכום בשקלים", "עמלה בשקלים", "שילם", "משותף", "הערה"];
  const rows = [...expenses]
    .sort((a, b) => a.date.localeCompare(b.date))
    .map((e) => [
      e.date, e.title, CATEGORY_BY_ID[e.category].label, e.isPreTrip ? "לפני הטיול" : "בדרך",
      e.paymentMethod === "cash" ? "מזומן" : "כרטיס", e.amount, e.currency, e.rateToIls, e.amountIls,
      e.feeIls, name(e.paidBy), e.isShared ? "כן" : "לא", e.note ?? "",
    ].map(esc).join(","));
  return "\uFEFF" + [head.map(esc).join(","), ...rows].join("\n");
}

"use client";
// מצב האפליקציה – נשמר ב-localStorage (עובד גם בלי אינטרנט)
import { create } from "zustand";
import { persist, createJSONStorage } from "zustand/middleware";
import type { Expense, Member, Rates, Settlement, TripInfo } from "@/lib/types";
import { defaultRates } from "@/lib/constants";
import { addDays, todayStr } from "@/lib/runway";
import { uid } from "@/lib/utils";
import { track } from "@/lib/track";

interface Data {
  trip: TripInfo;
  members: Member[];
  rates: Rates;
  expenses: Expense[];
  settlements: Settlement[];
  lastCurrency: string;
}

interface Actions {
  setTrip: (patch: Partial<TripInfo>) => void;
  addMember: (name: string) => void;
  renameMember: (id: string, name: string) => void;
  removeMember: (id: string) => boolean;
  setRate: (code: string, rate: number) => void;
  applyApiRates: (rates: Record<string, number>) => void;
  addExpense: (e: Omit<Expense, "id">) => void;
  deleteExpense: (id: string) => void;
  addSettlement: (s: Omit<Settlement, "id">) => void;
  deleteSettlement: (id: string) => void;
  importData: (raw: string) => { ok: boolean; error?: string };
  exportData: () => string;
  loadDemo: () => void;
  resetAll: () => void;
}

const initial = (): Data => ({
  trip: { name: "הטיול הגדול", budgetIls: 40000, startDate: todayStr(), endDate: "", meId: "me" },
  members: [{ id: "me", name: "אני" }],
  rates: defaultRates(),
  expenses: [],
  settlements: [],
  lastCurrency: "USD",
});

export const useTripStore = create<Data & Actions>()(
  persist(
    (set, get) => ({
      ...initial(),
      setTrip: (patch) => set((s) => ({ trip: { ...s.trip, ...patch } })),
      addMember: (name) => set((s) => ({ members: [...s.members, { id: uid(), name: name.trim() }] })),
      renameMember: (id, name) => set((s) => ({ members: s.members.map((m) => (m.id === id ? { ...m, name } : m)) })),
      removeMember: (id) => {
        const s = get();
        const used = s.expenses.some((e) => e.paidBy === id || e.splitAmong.includes(id)) ||
          s.settlements.some((x) => x.from === id || x.to === id);
        if (used || id === s.trip.meId || s.members.length <= 1) return false;
        set({ members: s.members.filter((m) => m.id !== id) });
        return true;
      },
      setRate: (code, rate) =>
        set((s) => ({ rates: { ...s.rates, [code]: { rateToIls: rate, source: "manual", updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() } } })),
      applyApiRates: (incoming: Record<string, number>) =>
        set((s) => {
          const next = { ...s.rates };
          const now = new Date().toISOString();
          for (const [code, r] of Object.entries(incoming)) if (r > 0) next[code] = { rateToIls: r, source: "api", updatedAt: now };
          return { rates: next };
        }),
      addExpense: (e) => {
        set((s) => ({ expenses: [...s.expenses, { ...e, id: uid() }], lastCurrency: e.currency }));
        // אנליטיקה אנונימית: נשלח רק אם המשתמש הסכים. בלי כותרת, הערה או בית עסק.
        track("expense_added", { category: e.category, currency: e.currency, amountIls: Math.round(e.amountIls), method: e.paymentMethod, shared: e.isShared, pre: e.isPreTrip });
      },
      deleteExpense: (id) => set((s) => ({ expenses: s.expenses.filter((e) => e.id !== id) })),
      addSettlement: (x) => set((s) => ({ settlements: [...s.settlements, { ...x, id: uid() }] })),
      deleteSettlement: (id) => set((s) => ({ settlements: s.settlements.filter((x) => x.id !== id) })),

      exportData: () => {
        const { trip, members, rates, expenses, settlements } = get();
        return JSON.stringify({ app: "big-trip", version: 1, trip, members, rates, expenses, settlements }, null, 2);
      },
      importData: (raw) => {
        try {
          const d = JSON.parse(raw);
          if (d?.app !== "big-trip" || !d.trip || !Array.isArray(d.members) || !Array.isArray(d.expenses))
            return { ok: false, error: "זה לא קובץ גיבוי של האפליקציה" };
          set({ trip: d.trip, members: d.members, rates: d.rates ?? defaultRates(), expenses: d.expenses, settlements: d.settlements ?? [] });
          return { ok: true };
        } catch {
          return { ok: false, error: "הקובץ פגום ואי אפשר לקרוא אותו" };
        }
      },

      // נתוני הדגמה: טיול בתאילנד עם דן, מאיה ותומר
      loadDemo: () => {
        const D = (n: number) => addDays(todayStr(), -n);
        const all = ["dan", "maya", "tomer"];
        const rate = { USD: 3.7, THB: 0.105 };
        const x = (o: Partial<Expense> & Pick<Expense, "title" | "category" | "amount" | "currency" | "date">): Omit<Expense, "id"> => {
          const r = o.currency === "ILS" ? 1 : (rate as Record<string, number>)[o.currency] ?? 1;
          return {
            paymentMethod: "card", isPreTrip: false, isShared: false, paidBy: "dan", splitAmong: [],
            rateToIls: r, amountIls: Math.round(o.amount * r * 100) / 100, feeIls: 0, ...o,
          };
        };
        const expenses: Expense[] = [
          x({ title: "טיסות לבנגקוק", category: "flights", amount: 3200, currency: "ILS", date: D(21), isPreTrip: true }),
          x({ title: "ביטוח נסיעות", category: "insurance", amount: 1100, currency: "ILS", date: D(24), isPreTrip: true }),
          x({ title: "תרמיל", category: "gear", amount: 890, currency: "ILS", date: D(26), isPreTrip: true }),
          x({ title: "משיכה בבנגקוק", category: "atm", amount: 10000, currency: "THB", date: D(9), amountIls: 1085, feeIls: 35, rateToIls: 0.105 }),
          x({ title: "וילה בצ'יאנג מאי", category: "accommodation", amount: 6000, currency: "THB", date: D(8), isShared: true, splitAmong: all, paidBy: "dan" }),
          x({ title: "ארוחת ערב", category: "food", amount: 1200, currency: "THB", date: D(7), paymentMethod: "cash", isShared: true, splitAmong: all, paidBy: "maya" }),
          x({ title: "טוסטוקים", category: "transport", amount: 450, currency: "THB", date: D(6), paymentMethod: "cash" }),
          x({ title: "שמורת פילים", category: "activities", amount: 2400, currency: "THB", date: D(5), isShared: true, splitAmong: all, paidBy: "tomer" }),
          x({ title: "סים תאילנדי", category: "sim", amount: 300, currency: "THB", date: D(8), paymentMethod: "cash" }),
          x({ title: "בירות", category: "nightlife", amount: 600, currency: "THB", date: D(4), paymentMethod: "cash" }),
          x({ title: "אוכל רחוב", category: "food", amount: 350, currency: "THB", date: D(3), paymentMethod: "cash" }),
          x({ title: "השכרת רכב", category: "transport", amount: 55, currency: "USD", date: D(2), isShared: true, splitAmong: all, paidBy: "dan" }),
          x({ title: "מתנות", category: "shopping", amount: 900, currency: "THB", date: D(1) }),
        ].map((e, i) => ({ ...e, id: `demo-${i}` }));
        set({
          trip: { name: "תאילנד עם החבר'ה", budgetIls: 25000, startDate: D(9), endDate: addDays(todayStr(), 40), meId: "dan" },
          members: [{ id: "dan", name: "דן" }, { id: "maya", name: "מאיה" }, { id: "tomer", name: "תומר" }],
          expenses, settlements: [], lastCurrency: "THB",
        });
      },
      resetAll: () => set(initial()),
    }),
    {
      name: "big-trip-v1",
      version: 1,
      storage: createJSONStorage(() => localStorage),
      skipHydration: true, // טוענים ידנית אחרי העלייה, כדי למנוע אי-התאמה בין שרת ללקוח
      partialize: (s) => ({ trip: s.trip, members: s.members, rates: s.rates, expenses: s.expenses, settlements: s.settlements, lastCurrency: s.lastCurrency }),
    },
  ),
);

// מצב ממשק זמני: פתיחת חלון הוספת הוצאה במצב מסוים
export type ExpenseMode = "road" | "pre" | "atm";
interface UiState {
  expenseModal: { open: boolean; mode: ExpenseMode };
  openExpense: (mode?: ExpenseMode) => void;
  closeExpense: () => void;
}
export const useUiStore = create<UiState>((set) => ({

  const b = computeBalances(members, [ex({ amountIls: 500, isShared: false }), ex({ amountIls: 500, category: "atm" })]);
  assert.deepEqual(Object.values(b), [0, 0, 0]);
});

test("מינימום העברות: 4 אנשים, 2 העברות במקום 3", () => {
  // a ו-b חייבים 50 כל אחד, c ו-d זכאים ל-50 כל אחד  ->  שתי העברות מספיקות
  const t = minimizeTransfers({ a: -5000, b: -5000, c: 5000, d: 5000 });
  assert.equal(t.length, 2);
});

test("סכום ההעברות סוגר את כל היתרות", () => {
  const exps = [
    ex({ amountIls: 300, paidBy: "dan" }),
    ex({ amountIls: 150, paidBy: "maya", splitAmong: ["maya", "tomer"] }),
    ex({ amountIls: 90, paidBy: "tomer" }),
  ];
  const { balances, transfers } = settleGroup(members, exps);
  const after = { ...balances };
  for (const t of transfers) { after[t.from] += t.amountIls * 100; after[t.to] -= t.amountIls * 100; }
  assert.deepEqual(Object.values(after).map((v) => Math.round(v)), [0, 0, 0]);
});

test("העברה בפועל מקטינה את החוב", () => {
  const exps = [ex({ amountIls: 300 })];
  const { transfers } = settleGroup(members, exps, [{ id: "s", from: "maya", to: "dan", amountIls: 100, date: "2026-01-11" }]);
  assert.deepEqual(transfers, [{ from: "tomer", to: "dan", amountIls: 100 }]);
});

test("מסלול: תקציב 10,000, ביום 10 הוצאו 3,000 בדרך -> 300 ליום, 16 ימים נשארו", () => {
  const r = computeRunway({
    budgetIls: 10000, startDate: "2026-01-01", today: "2026-01-10",
    costs: [{ date: "2026-01-05", ils: 3000, isPreTrip: false }, { date: "2025-12-01", ils: 2000, isPreTrip: true }],
  });
  assert.equal(r.roadSpent, 3000);
  assert.equal(r.remaining, 5000);
  assert.equal(r.daysElapsed, 10);
  assert.equal(r.avgDaily, 300);
  assert.equal(Math.floor(r.daysLeft!), 16); // 5000/300
  assert.equal(r.runOutDate, "2026-01-26");
});

test("מסלול: חריגה מהתקציב", () => {
  const r = computeRunway({ budgetIls: 100, today: "2026-01-02", costs: [{ date: "2026-01-02", ils: 150, isPreTrip: false }] });
  assert.equal(r.status, "over");
  assert.equal(r.daysLeft, 0);
});

test("מסלול: יעד סיום – קצב מומלץ ו-'מתהדק'", () => {
  const r = computeRunway({
    budgetIls: 10000, startDate: "2026-01-01", endDate: "2026-02-10", today: "2026-01-10",
    costs: [{ date: "2026-01-05", ils: 5000, isPreTrip: false }],
  });
  assert.equal(r.daysToEnd, 32);
  assert.equal(r.recommendedDaily, 5000 / 32);
  assert.equal(r.status, "tight");
});

import { myShareIls, cashWallet, summarize } from "../src/lib/selectors.ts";
import { defaultRates } from "../src/lib/constants.ts";

test("החלק שלי: משותף מחולק, אישי של אחר = 0, ATM = עמלה בלבד", () => {
  assert.equal(myShareIls(ex({ amountIls: 300 }) as any, "maya"), 100);
  assert.equal(myShareIls(ex({ amountIls: 300, isShared: false, paidBy: "dan" }) as any, "maya"), 0);
  assert.equal(myShareIls(ex({ amountIls: 1000, category: "atm", feeIls: 25, isShared: false }) as any, "dan"), 25);
});

test("ארנק מזומן: משיכה 10,000฿, הוצאה 4,000฿ במזומן -> נשאר 6,000฿", () => {
  const list = [
    ex({ category: "atm", isShared: false, amount: 10000, currency: "THB", amountIls: 1050, feeIls: 0 }),
    ex({ isShared: false, paymentMethod: "cash", amount: 4000, currency: "THB", amountIls: 420 }),
  ] as any[];
  const [w] = cashWallet(list, "dan", defaultRates());
  assert.equal(w.balance, 6000);
  assert.equal(Math.round(w.valueIls), 630); // 6000 × 0.105
});

test("סיכום: מזומן + כרטיס = יתרה כוללת", () => {
  const trip = { name: "t", budgetIls: 5000, startDate: "2026-01-01", endDate: "", meId: "dan" };
  const list = [
    ex({ category: "atm", isShared: false, amount: 10000, currency: "THB", amountIls: 1050, feeIls: 50 }),
    ex({ isShared: false, paymentMethod: "cash", amount: 4000, currency: "THB", amountIls: 420 }),
  ] as any[];
  const s = summarize({ trip, expenses: list, rates: defaultRates(), today: "2026-01-05" });
  assert.equal(Math.round((s.cashIls + s.cardIls) * 100), Math.round(s.runway.remaining * 100));
});

<div class="w"><div class="top"><div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px"><img id="logo" alt="" width="44" height="44" style="border-radius:12px;display:block"><div><h1>יאללה טיול <span class="chipS" style="font-size:11px;vertical-align:middle">BETA</span></h1><div class="m" id="title"></div></div></div><div class="tb"><span class="chipS" id="sync">נשמר במכשיר</span><button class="g" aria-label="מצב כהה או בהיר" onclick="theme()">◐</button><button class="g" aria-label="מדריך למסך הזה" onclick="guide(V,0)">?</button><button class="g" onclick="inst()">הוסף לטלפון</button></div></div><div id="v"></div></div>
